label: Web Console Dashboard
type: the Couchbase Web Console screen where statistics are assembled as user-defined groups of charts. Assembling them requires Full Admin or Bucket Admin; merely displaying charts for all buckets is available to Full Admin, Cluster Admin, Read Only Admin, Security Admin and Read-Only Security Admin. Retains the last 30 days of statistics.
evidence: Users with the **Full Admin** or **Bucket Admin** role can assemble statistics as _groups_ of _charts_, on the **Dashboard** of Couchbase Web Console.
users with the Full Admin, Cluster Admin, Read Only Admin, Security Admin, or Read-Only Security Admin roles can display the charts for all buckets in the cluster.
Note that the UI returns the last 30 days of statistics.
note: The two role lists are the point: a five-role list for VIEWING and a two-role list for CONFIGURING, on one screen. That distinction is invisible from the role catalogue, which files one entry per role and cannot say that a single screen enforces two different permission sets - and it is why round 26 could promote role:security-admin and role:ro-security-admin from procedural evidence at all.
